title: QuadFund
tagline: Open platform for project funding and support, where individuals can present their projects, and each person gets one vote per project.
description:
Establish an open platform for project funding and support, where individuals can present their projects, and each person gets one vote per project.

Host product-building events driven by votes rather than funding size, distributing funds based on Quadratic Funding algorithm results.

Promote socially beneficial projects, fostering market-wide product quality enhancement through increased exposure and funding.

Offer backing to aspiring startups through Venture Capitalist support.
how_its_made: The tech stack employed comprises Next.js for frontend development, leveraging its efficient rendering capabilities. Solidity is utilized for smart contract development, ensuring secure and decentralized operations. GraphQL serves as the query language for interfacing with the backend, facilitating flexible data retrieval. The Subgraph framework is integrated to efficiently index and query blockchain data, enhancing scalability and performance. Rainbowkit likely contributes to UI/UX enhancements, while Sepolia Blockchain provides the underlying decentralized infrastructure for seamless transactions and data management.
